description: Reverse-ETL / audience activation: upload an upstream DataFrame into an X (Twitter) Ads Tailored Audience via the single custom_audiences/:id/users endpoint. Each row becomes one user object carrying one or more SHA-256 hashed identifier(s) (email/phone). Supports 'add' (operation_type=Update) and 'remove' (operation_type=Delete). Requests are chunked at 2,500 users per X's documented limit.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row contributes hashed identifier values (email/phone) into one X Ads user object.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (custom_audience_id / operation_type / requests_sent / rows_submitted / success_count / total_count / last_response). X processes audience changes in batches every 6-8 hours on its side.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

custom_audience_id.label: Custom Audience ID
custom_audience_id.description: Target X Ads Tailored Audience ID. Must already exist.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> identifier type ('email' or 'phone'). Values are SHA-256 hashed before upload.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: 'add' maps to X operation_type=Update; 'remove' maps to operation_type=Delete.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Twitter/X Ads Tailored Audience Upsert
